Lazy sparse affine matrices

sparse_affine_matrix-class.Rd

Objects of class sparse_affine_matrix represent sparse matrix preprocessing of the form sweep(x, 2, scale, "*") + shift without materializing dense centered columns. The companion sparse_affine_transpose class represents its transpose.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix'
dim(x)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose'
dim(x)

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix'
dimnames(x)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose'
dimnames(x)

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix'
as.matrix(x, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose'
as.matrix(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,ANY,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,ANY,missing,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,missing,ANY,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,missing,missing,ANY'
x[i, j, ..., drop = TRUE]

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix'
t(x)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose'
t(x)

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,ANY'
x %*% y
# S4 method for class 'ANY,sparse_affine_matrix'
x %*% y
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose,ANY'
x %*% y
# S4 method for class 'ANY,sparse_affine_transpose'
x %*% y

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,missing'
crossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,ANY'
crossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'ANY,sparse_affine_matrix'
crossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose,missing'
crossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose,ANY'
crossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)

# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,missing'
tcrossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_matrix,ANY'
tcrossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'ANY,sparse_affine_matrix'
tcrossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose,missing'
tcrossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)
# S4 method for class 'sparse_affine_transpose,ANY'
tcrossprod(x, y = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A sparse affine matrix, sparse affine transpose, or compatible left-hand matrix argument.

y

A compatible right-hand matrix argument.

i, j

Row and column indices for subsetting.

drop

Whether to drop dimensions when subsetting.

...

Additional arguments passed to the generic.

Details

These classes are implementation details returned by sparse-aware preprocessing steps such as center() and standardize() when sparse inputs would otherwise be densified by centering. Users normally do not construct these objects directly.

The documented S4 methods provide the matrix operations used by downstream estimators: dimensions and names, subsetting, explicit materialization through as.matrix(), transpose views, matrix multiplication, and cross-products. The algebraic methods apply the affine offset during the multiplication so that common projections and decompositions can operate without first expanding the preprocessed sparse input to a dense matrix.

Value

Dimension and name methods return the corresponding base values. Subsetting returns either another sparse affine view or a materialized vector or matrix when drop = TRUE. Multiplication and cross-product methods return base matrix results matching the corresponding dense affine calculation.

See also

prep(), fit_transform(), transform()
